author: Kero_Lahtinen
body: Looks solid, I would suggest grinding for a nothren armor and greaves as they will give you quite a push in hp, def and even a little bit of res. With nothren enemies pretty much everywhere in your tier, the baldur will come along soon enough. Depending on how active you play, you could go ahead and demonforge them at the end, given you find good ornate pieces. That's what I did.

author: Rymachelin
body: try to get a cockatrice mail. Petrify Res and high def, plenty of jewel slots. Great Cockatrice drops it and you find it plenty in boss gauntlets. even thou it needs 4 materials (Hide Runestone Silver and Stone) its easy to MF and DF
